identity.description: Diameter Identity (FQDN) of this node, e.g., 'bob.example.com'. Must be unique in the realm.

realm.description: Diameter Realm this node belongs to. Usually the DNS domain.

listen_addrs.description: List of IP addresses to bind listening sockets to (e.g., all interfaces, specific IPs). Each entry supports IPv4 or IPv6.

items.description: An IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to listen on.

port.description: Diameter base protocol port. Most deployments use the standard 3868.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS (Diameter over TLS) for secure transport.

tls_cert_file.description: Absolute path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_file.description: Absolute path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_ca_file.description: Optional path to a CA certificate bundle for validating peer certs (PEM format).

peers.description: List of Diameter peers to connect to or accept connections from. At least one peer is needed for inter-node communication.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the peer (e.g., 'sbc.example.com').

port.description: Port number of the peer. Usually 3868.

realm.description: Realm of the peer (e.g., 'sbc.example.com'). Required for routing.

auth_app_ids.description: Optional list of Authentication Application IDs (e.g., [16777250] for 3GPP S6a).

extensions.description: List of FreeDiameter extensions (modules) to load at startup.

path.description: Absolute path to the extension shared library (e.g., '/usr/lib/freediameter/libfreediameter-s6a.so').

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logs. Use DEBUG only for troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If empty, logs go to stdout.
